title: GATE 2027 Eligibility, Explained with Official Links
description: GATE 2027 eligibility: third year or higher of any undergraduate degree, or a completed one, and no age limit. What the official IIT Madras brochure says, in plain language, with common cases worked through.
author: Studyloaf Team

content.body: GATE's eligibility rules are broad. This post sets out only what the GATE 2027 information brochure from IIT Madras states (section 6.1 and Table 2), applies it to common cases, and points you to the brochure or the GATE helpdesk for anything less straightforward. The brochure and the official eligibility page are linked below, and they decide.

content.heading: What the brochure says
list: A candidate currently in the third or higher year of any undergraduate degree programme, or who has completed any government-approved degree in engineering, technology, architecture, science, commerce, arts or humanities, is eligible
A candidate pursuing, or holding, a degree higher than those in the brochure's Table 2 is eligible

Table 2 sets out the rule degree by degree. For example: B.E., B.Tech. and B.Pharm. from the third year; three-year B.Sc., B.A., B.Com. and BCA from the third year; M.B.B.S., B.D.S., B.V.Sc. and the other listed medical degrees from the fifth semester; M.Sc., M.A. and M.C.A. from the first year; and B.Sc. (Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry) from the third year

table.caption: Applying the GATE 2027 brochure (section 6.1 and Table 2)

Third-year student of a three-year B.Sc.
B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./BCA: currently in the third year or completed
Completed a government-approved degree in commerce
M.B.B.S. student in the fifth semester

M.Sc./M.A./M.C.A.: first year or higher, or completed

Degree from outside India, or a professional society certification
Read the brochure's eligibility section (6.1 and Table 2) or ask the GATE helpdesk

content.heading: Not sure? Ask the official source
content.body: If your degree, institution or situation isn't one of the clear-cut rows above, don't rely on a summary, this one included. Read section 6.1 and Table 2 of the GATE 2027 information brochure, or contact the GATE 2027 helpdesk at IIT Madras: helpdesk@gate.iitm.ac.in, phone 044-22578200 (as listed in the brochure).

content.heading: Eligibility is not admission
content.body: In the brochure's words, qualifying GATE does not guarantee admission, scholarship or a job: admission to any institute and recruitment by any employer depend entirely on that institute's or employer's own criteria. Read the notice of every programme you're aiming for, not just the GATE rules.

content.heading: Choosing a paper
content.body: GATE 2027 has 30 test papers. You can appear in one, or in two, as long as the pair is on the brochure's list of allowed two-paper combinations (Table 4, also on the official site).

content.heading: Common mistakes
list: Assuming a second-year B.Tech student can apply early. The rule starts at the third year
Assuming GATE has an age limit. It doesn't
Treating eligibility for GATE as eligibility for a programme. The admitting institute decides
Relying on a summary for an unusual degree. Check the brochure's Table 2 or ask the helpdesk
